fast.notes: ESLint, Biome, Knip, all typechecks, boundaries, native auth schema, contracts and domain tests pass on the delivery source.

observedBehavior: The six-area UI provides contextual Create and Ask Brain entry points, reviewed plan materialization, resource and schedule operation, and all Studios without requiring YAML or terminal commands.
Navigation, focus restoration, responsive layouts, keyboard operation and light/dark themes pass at 390, 768 and 1440 pixels.
Plan confirmation creates exact WorkItems and dependencies; replanning retains unchanged work and prior execution history.
Durable occurrences retain stable identity and complete history across replay and Governor restart without duplicate dispatch.

Personal-host schedules pin the run and every job to the selected runner; offline wait creates no run, recovery uses the same runner, and offline fail records a failed occurrence without managed fallback.
Git integration and configuration publication use the TypeScript isomorphic-git protocol client and a real smart-HTTP fixture, not provider-specific APIs.
The Git HTTP test fixture handles early child-process input closure without an unhandled EPIPE; the complete Studio publication matrix passes.
E093/E097 and E101-E110 are covered, and the certification matrix covers all 110 scenarios.
limitations: No live Anthropic or customer-system qualification is claimed for T25 and T41-T43.
Independent release certification remains separate from this in-repository verification.
Historical G01-G08 and runtime-readiness records were not manually promoted.
